sloka: एवं शुद्धसमाचारा देवगन्धर्वसन्निधौ ।लङ्काद्वीपे महेन्द्रेण मम हस्ते निवेशिता ।। ७.४५.९ ॥
transliteration: evaṁ śuddhasamācārā devagandharvasannidhau ।laṅkādvīpe mahendreṇa mama haste niveśitā ।। 7.45.9 ॥

translations.english: Thus, she of pure conduct was entrusted into my hands by the great Indra himself on the island of Lanka, in the presence of gods and Gandharvas.
